sources.label: Morphe patches to remove ads, analytics, apk junk, debug info, duplicate graphic
sources.author: BlazeFTL
patch_list: Adds a copy icon after every link in release details. Configurable in Mod settings.
Hides Recent discussions, Reviews and Contests sections on Home. Configurable in Mod settings.
Hides the Go premium button and the premium download button. Configurable in Mod settings.
Adds a Keyword filter entry to the 3-dot menu to hide posts by title keywords, with long-press hide and copy.
Applies the Material red and purple palette to the Apps and Games tabs.
Adds a Mod settings entry to the 3-dot menu to show or hide sidebar items and toggle mod features.
Opens the Latest list for the current content type on launch. Configurable in Mod settings.
Launches the home screen directly instead of the splash screen.
